mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_organization WHERE id=#{org}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_schedule_lock (organization_id) VALUES (#{org}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE organization_id=VALUES(organization_id)
mapper.select: SELECT organization_id FROM edu_schedule_lock WHERE organization_id=#{org} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_session s LEFT JOIN edu_session_student ss ON ss.session_id=s.id AND ss.organization_id=s.organization_id WHERE s.organization_id=#{org} AND s.status='SCHEDULED' AND s.starts_at < #{end} AND s.ends_at > #{start} AND (s.teacher_id=#{teacher} OR s.room_key=#{room} OR ss.student_id IN #{student})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_session s JOIN edu_session_student ss ON ss.session_id=s.id AND ss.organization_id=s.organization_id WHERE s.organization_id=#{org} AND s.makeup_for_session_id=#{source} AND ss.enrollment_id=#{enrollment} AND s.status='SCHEDULED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units),0) FROM edu_credit_entry WHERE organization_id=#{org} AND enrollment_id=#{enrollment}
